quarterly_data.signal: AAOI's 8-K: on June 25, 2026 AAOI entered a design-build agreement with LCC3 Solution Inc. for its OMD 3 (FAB4) cleanroom construction project at 11555 North Spectrum Blvd., Houston, Texas: approximately 195,591 square feet of ISO Class 6-certified cleanroom space, 36,500 square feet of office space and 73,780 square feet for shipping and receiving, quality and reliability testing, and inventory operations. The total contract amount is approximately $94.1 million, and the project has a targeted Substantial Completion date of January 10, 2027.
